cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Helpful Culprit
cards.instruction: Hide that the problem is your fault while enthusiastically helping investigate it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's investigate the broken vase. I taught you to notice small details; start with that open window.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good eye, finally. But don't stop at the first clue. I'll help you inspect the glue cupboard.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's a piece of the vase stuck to your thumb.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent, you've kept looking. Get the tweezers and I'll show you how to remove evidence without leaving your fingerprints on it.
